name: Mamapuri!? ~Wagaya no Dousei Tsuushinbo~
original_name: ママぷりっ!? ～我が家の同棲通信簿～
source:
One day, my father suddenly says to me, "I think you'll need your mother, Keita." My mother passed away when I was a kid. I was sad at first, but I somehow managed to accept it. But why now...? Anyway, my father brings four ladies in front of me and says, "The girl who goes with you the best will become your mother. You live with them for a while and score them." I don't need my mother anymore, so I just give them low scores. Like this, I start living together with four ladies...

[From Himeya Shop]
